title_en: Fall 2026 Graduation Project Final Presentation and Poster File Submission
summary: Students taking the Fall 2026 graduation project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) must submit their poster as an A1 portrait PDF through the online form by Monday, November 9, 23:59, and have their advisor review the draft thesis and poster by Monday, November 16. At least one student from each lab must take part in panel setup on Thursday, November 19, at 15:00; students who have a class then are excluded. They must also attend the final presentation on Friday, November 20, from 10:00 to 16:00, arriving before 10:00. Both events take place in the 1st-floor corridor of Building 301.
applies_to: Students taking the graduation project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) in Fall 2026. Attendance at the final presentation is checked and counts towards evaluation. For panel setup, at least one student from each lab must attend; students who have a class at that time are excluded. Attendance of teaching assistants is not checked; they take part only if needed and are not required to.

steps: Prepare your poster as a PDF file, A1 size (594 mm x 841 mm), portrait orientation, not too large; do not use PPT or HWP.
Name the file "module name_advisor name_student name" (for example: 바이오_김OO교수님_박OO); for a team project, one representative submits it named "advisor name_names of all team members".

Upload the PDF through the Google Form (https://forms.gle/Vm9HY1ZiX9nyK5pCA) by Monday, November 9, 23:59 to receive free printing; if you miss this deadline, print the A1 portrait poster yourself at your own expense.
If you need to revise the poster, submit the revised file once only, with "[수정본]" at the start of the file name (for example: [수정본]김전기 교수님_박정보).
Have your advisor review your draft thesis and draft poster by Monday, November 16.

Come to the 1st-floor corridor of Building 301 (in front of Room 118) by 15:00 on Thursday, November 19, to set up your presentation panel (at least one student per lab; students with a class are excluded).

Before the presentation day, prepare tape for attaching the poster to the panel, your own power extension cord if you need power, and a printed mySNU timetable if you need an absence confirmation for another class that day.
On Friday, November 20, arrive at the 1st-floor corridor of Building 301 before 10:00 for the attendance check.
If you have another class that day, submit your printed mySNU timetable at the desk and collect your absence confirmation.

Use desks and chairs from Building 301 Room 104 and the designated lecture rooms, and stay at your panel from 10:00 to 16:00 for the individual judging; be present at the attendance checks at 10:30, 12:00 (meal pick-up) and 15:30.
After all modules have been judged, remove the posters together with the other students and put the panels, desks and chairs back in order.
translation:
[Fall 2026] Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) Final Presentation and Poster File Submission

Fall 2026 Graduation Project Final Presentation and Poster File Submission

<Final Presentation>
- The final presentation is scheduled for Friday, November 20, 10:00–16:00 (judging time), in the 1st-floor corridor of Building 301.
- Arrive before 10:00 for the attendance check.
※ If you need an absence confirmation to submit for another class held on that day, please bring a printed copy of your mySNU timetable. It will be issued after your timetable is checked on the day.

<Preparation>
*Poster submission (by Monday, November 9, 23:59)
Link: https://forms.gle/Vm9HY1ZiX9nyK5pCA

1. Poster submission
- Only PDF files can be uploaded / size A1 / portrait orientation.
- File name on submission: "module name_advisor name_student name", e.g. 바이오_김OO교수님_박OO
 * For team projects, one representative should send it. (File name: advisor's name_names of all team members)
- A revised version may be submitted only once, and you must add "[수정본]" (revised version) to it, e.g. [수정본]김전기 교수님_박정보

2. Poster printing
- Printing of one poster per person is provided.
- Poster size: please follow the A1 standard (594 mm x 841 mm, portrait).
 * Those printing at their own expense should also print in A1 size. A landscape poster may be difficult to attach to the panel.
- Poster file format: PDF (not too large) / A1 size (PPT and HWP cannot be printed).
※ After the deadline of Monday, November 9, 23:59, you must print the poster yourself at your own expense.
※ The print request will be sent to the printing company on the afternoon of Tuesday, November 10.

3. Panel setup
- Panel setup takes place on Thursday, November 19, at 15:00.
- As this is the setup of your own presentation panel, please come to the 1st-floor corridor of Building 301 (in front of Room 118) by 15:00.
 (At least one person per lab must come; students who have a class are excluded.)

4. Project day
- You must bring Scotch tape that can be attached to the panel.
- Power extension: if you need power for a laptop or other device, prepare it individually.
- Desks: use desks and chairs from Building 301 Room 104 and the designated lecture rooms, and you must also put them back afterwards.
 * The project ends after everyone together has removed the posters and finished tidying the panels, desks and chairs.

5. Attendance
- Attendance is checked at 10:30 / 12:00 (at meal pick-up) / 15:30 (by roll call or in turn).
- If you are absent at all three checks, you will be marked absent. (Missing one check because of a class is accepted.)
- If you have an overlapping class, print your mySNU timetable, submit it at the desk on the day, and collect an absence confirmation.
- To avoid an evaluation disadvantage due to absence during professor judging, please remain at your place from 10:00 to 16:00.
 * Please note that, depending on the judges' schedules, judging may continue after 15:00.
 (Judging time: 10:00–16:00 / the whole project presentation event ends when judging of all modules is finished.)
- Judging is done individually; if a student is not present because of attending a class and is therefore not evaluated, this is the student's own responsibility.
- Teaching assistants' attendance is not checked. (Participate only if needed; not required.)

For further questions, please contact the undergraduate department office (the contact person, phone number and email address are given in the original notice).

Addition) You must have your draft thesis and draft poster reviewed by your advisor by Monday, November 16.
